summary_en: Capital cost management policy update. Company re-evaluated current position and revised initiatives on cost of capital and share price awareness for FY3/26–3/28 planning cycle, following completion of FY3/23–3/25 plan above all targets.
title_en: Update on Initiatives to Realize Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 23 June 2026, Daito Koun disclosed an update to its capital cost and share price management initiative, first announced on 14 May 2024. The company evaluated its current position and revised its policy approach following completion of the 8th Medium-Term Plan (FY3/23–3/25), which exceeded all published targets. The 9th Medium-Term Plan (FY3/26–3/28) will introduce updated measures targeting capital efficiency improvement. Specific targets, KPIs, and execution timelines are detailed in the attached disclosure document dated 23 June 2026.
